description_en: Deletes a sharing authorization for a data work
description_zh: 删除数据作品的一个分享授权
name: CancelReportShare

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data work. Data works include data portals, dashboards, workbooks, and ad hoc queries
parameters.help_zh: 作品的ID。这里的作品包括数据门户，仪表板，电子表格，自助取数
parameters.name: report_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the sharee. It can be a Quick BI user ID or a user group ID.

If ShareToType is set to 0 (user), the value is the user ID.
If ShareToType is set to 1 (user group), the value is the user group ID.
If ShareToType is set to 2 (organization), the value is the organization ID
parameters.help_zh:
被分享者的ID，可能是Quick BI的用户ID，也可能是用户组ID。

ShareToType=0（用户）时，ShareTo为用户ID。
ShareToType=1（用户组）时，ShareTo为用户组ID。
ShareToType=2（组织）时，ShareTo为组织ID
parameters.name: share_to_ids

parameters.help_en:
The deletion method. Valid values:

0: Delete by user.
1: Delete by user group.
2: Delete by organization
parameters.help_zh:
删除方式。取值范围：

0：按用户删除
1：按用户组删除
2：按组织删除
parameters.name: share_to_type

Result.description_en:
The execution result of the API operation. Valid values:

true: The execution succeeded.
false: The execution failed
Result.description_zh:
返回接口执行结果。取值范围：

true：执行成功
false：执行失败

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request succeeded.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
是否请求成功。取值范围：

true：请求成功
false：请求失败
